summary: Feed s150_double is degraded: NDR missing required VLAN 20 (50% packets untagged) and overloaded by 16.26 Gbps microbursts exceeding 10 Gbps port (163% capacity, 2 intervals).

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN/TAP trunk is stripping 802.1Q tags or not forwarding VLAN 20. 50% of packets arrive untagged and VLAN 20 is completely absent despite being required (10,20). Typical cause is broker egress set to access/strip-vlan or SPAN source trunk not including VLAN 20.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR is blind to all VLAN 20 traffic - 50% of expected coverage missing. Cannot detect lateral movement, east-west attacks or segmentation violations in VLAN 20, creating a major detection blind spot.

recommended_fix.why: Preserve and forward 802.1Q tags end-to-end for VLANs 10 and 20 so NDR receives correctly tagged traffic and regains full segment visibility.

findings.root_cause: Aggregate/burst traffic peaks at 16.26 Gbps in 1ms intervals overwhelms the single 10 Gbps NDR port (163% of capacity). Broker is feeding full aggregate to one tool port without load-balancing or burst buffering, causing buffer overrun.
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR drops packets during bursts and loses full payload and flow state it requires (needs_full_payload=true, needs_both_directions=true). Results in broken session reassembly, missed detections and degraded NDR efficacy.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute traffic across 2x10G tool ports with flow-aware hashing to keep per-port utilization <80% and absorb 16+ Gbps bursts without loss while preserving both directions per flow.
